item.title: Speak Up for June — B+ | Fighting Childhood Cancer
item.description: If you’re having a tough day, look at cute, little June. As you’ll see from June’s family’s note, they live 3.5 hours away from their hospital!!! They were at risk of losing their car before B+ stepped in.

item.title: Happy Thanksgiving — B+ | Fighting Childhood Cancer
item.description: Mason is only 13 years old, he’s been diagnosed with brain cancer, lost his dad to an accident, is one of 4 kids, and lives hours from his hospitals…yes, plural - hospitals. That’s the life of a child with cancer.
